topic.title: Why starting a SIP at 24 beats starting at 32 even if you stop early

cta: Comment START if you will begin this month
title: Neha invests less than Karan but ends up richer
description: Two friends put ₹3,000 a month into the same SIP at 12% a year. One starts at 24 and stops at 32, the other starts at 32 and continues till 58. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
